Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Replying to Tom About Finding Part-Time Jobs in Singapore
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend, Tom, who lives in Singapore. You are planning to go there and want to find a part-time job. Write an email responding to Tom:

- Tell him what types of part-time jobs you are interested in applying for
- Share your plans and timeline for working part-time in Singapore
- Describe the personal qualities and skills you have that make you suitable for those jobs
title: Task 1.1: Replying to Tom About Finding Part-Time Jobs in Singapore
content:
You have received an email from your friend, Tom, who lives in Singapore. You are planning to go there and want to find a part-time job. Write an email responding to Tom:

- Tell him what types of part-time jobs you are interested in applying for
- Share your plans and timeline for working part-time in Singapore
- Describe the personal qualities and skills you have that make you suitable for those jobs

body.answer: I would like to give you information on the part-time jobs I am interested in, such as a café server, a shop assistant, or an IT support helper.
body.example: Working at a coffee shop or bookstore near my campus would allow me to practice English with customers every day.
body.reason: These jobs provide knowledge and experience in customer service, help me adjust and adapt to the social environment, and bring extra income to improve my living standard.
body.requirement: What types of part-time jobs you are interested in applying for

body.answer: I would like to let you know that I plan to arrive in Singapore next month and start applying for part-time shifts in my second week.
body.example: I will prepare my CV this week, attend interviews during my first two weeks there, and begin working 15 hours a week from the following month.
body.reason: Working on evenings and weekends fits comfortably within my budget and daily routine without hurting my studies.
body.requirement: Your plans and timeline for working part-time in Singapore

body.answer: I would like to let you know that I am hardworking, friendly, and good at communication and basic computer skills.
body.example: Last year, I worked part-time at a bookshop in Ho Chi Minh City where I helped customers find books and handled payments accurately.
body.reason: I can solve problems quickly at work and adjust well to a new environment, which makes me reliable for busy teams.
body.requirement: Personal qualities and skills that make you suitable for those jobs

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Advantages and Challenges of Learning a New Language
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Learning a new language brings many valuable opportunities in education, career development, and cultural exchange. However, learners also face numerous challenges along the way."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and challenges of learning a new language. Support your arguments with specific reasons and relevant examples.
title: Task 2.1: Advantages and Challenges of Learning a New Language
content:
Read the following statement:

"Learning a new language brings many valuable opportunities in education, career development, and cultural exchange. However, learners also face numerous challenges along the way."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and challenges of learning a new language. Support your arguments with specific reasons and relevant examples.

body1.example: For instance, getting a B2 English certificate helped my brother apply for an international company with a higher salary and learn about foreign cultures.
body1.focus: Advantages: Better career chances and broader cultural knowledge
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... / Advantages (Body Chunk B)
body1.point: Learning a new language helps improve people's living standard through better job opportunities and lets them gain a deeper understanding of other cultures.

body2.example: For example, busy adults often struggle to memorize new grammar after work and feel shy speaking with native speakers, though free AI tools now make practice cheaper.
body2.focus: Challenges: High cost of time, effort, and speaking shyness
body2.point: However, mastering a language costs a great deal of time, effort, and money for classes, and learners often find it hard to fit daily practice into a busy routine.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, learning a new language brings valuable career and cultural benefits despite the time and effort required, so learners should practice consistently using smart study tools.

intro.ld1: improve career chances and broaden cultural knowledge
intro.ld2: managing time, study costs, and practice difficulties

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.2: Replying to Your Younger Brother About Your Birthday Party
Nội dung chi tiết:
Your younger brother wants to organize a birthday party for you and sent an email asking for your preferences. Write an informal email responding to him:

- Tell him the place or venue where you would like to celebrate
- Suggest the best date and time for the party
- Mention the birthday gift you would love to receive
title: Task 1.2: Replying to Your Younger Brother About Your Birthday Party
content:
Your younger brother wants to organize a birthday party for you and sent an email asking for your preferences. Write an informal email responding to him:

- Tell him the place or venue where you would like to celebrate
- Suggest the best date and time for the party
- Mention the birthday gift you would love to receive

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that celebrating with a cozy dinner at home would be the best choice.
body.example: We can decorate our living room with simple balloons and cook hotpot together with our parents and close friends.
body.reason: Crowded, noisy public venues easily make people feel stressed, whereas home offers a quiet, cozy environment that helps us build a strong sense of belonging through face-to-face interaction.
body.requirement: The place or venue where you would like to celebrate

body.answer: Why don't we hold the party next Saturday evening at 6:30 p.m.?
body.example: Our parents finish work early on Saturday, and our friends can stay until 9:30 p.m. without worrying about getting up early the next day.
body.reason: Saturday evening is fast and convenient for everyone because nobody has to rush after work or school, helping us reach a healthy balance between work and family time.
body.requirement: The best date and time for the party

body.answer: I would like to let you know that I would love to receive a good English novel or a wireless mouse for my laptop.
body.example: You can easily pick up a paperback novel at the bookstore near your school, and I will read it every evening before bed.
body.reason: A novel lets me dive into the world of a book to broaden my mind and relieve stress, while a wireless mouse helps me make the most of new technology to improve productivity.
body.requirement: The birthday gift you would love to receive

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.2: Impacts of Workplace Stress on Employees and Companies
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In today's fast-paced and competitive work environment, workplace stress has become a serious concern that affects not only the health and well-being of individual employees but also the overall performance of companies."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of workplace stress on both employees and companies. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your viewpoint.
title: Task 2.2: Impacts of Workplace Stress on Employees and Companies
content:
Read the following statement:

"In today's fast-paced and competitive work environment, workplace stress has become a serious concern that affects not only the health and well-being of individual employees but also the overall performance of companies."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of workplace stress on both employees and companies. Provide specific reasons and examples to support your viewpoint.

body1.example: For instance, workers who skip lunch, work overtime, and check emails late at night often get sick and spend their savings on hospital bills later.
body1.focus: Effects on employees: Poor physical and mental health
body1.frame: First of all, [debai] directly affects... / Effects (Body Chunk D)
body1.point: Heavy workplace stress harms employees' physical and mental health, causes burnout, and stops them from reaching a healthy balance between work and family time.

body2.example: For example, when tired employees cannot focus on deadlines or decide to change jobs every few months, the company loses skilled staff and spends more money hiring replacements.
body2.focus: Effects on companies: Lower productivity and high staff turnover
body2.frame: Secondly, in the long run... / Effects (Body Chunk D)
body2.point: For companies, stressed workers make more mistakes, show lower productivity, and often quit early, which hurts teamwork and business results.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, workplace stress damages both workers' health and company performance, so employers should set reasonable workloads to keep staff healthy and productive.

intro.ld1: harming employees' health and work-life balance
intro.ld2: reducing company productivity and keeping skilled staff
